title: The Tagged line names recipients (2 then N more), not the author or emails
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user.
  • The Notifications page is open on the Inbox tab.
  • A note that tags you and four other people (for example Ashlee Thomas, Ashley Schultz, Amy Fernandez, Angelica Harper), written by a second user on a work order, tagging each person in that order.
  • A note you wrote whose only recipient is you.
custom_steps:
1. On the Notifications page (click the bell icon at the top right; it opens on the Inbox tab), read the Tagged: line on the four-recipient notification and hover it.
  2. Confirm the order of the two inline names matches the order the author tagged them.
  3. On the author-only note, look for a Tagged: line.
  4. Confirm no email addresses appear, including on hover.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • When the note has recipients other than its author, a Tagged: line names them, showing two names inline then "+N more" for the rest (e.g. "Ashlee Thomas, Ashley Schultz +2 more"); the two shown are the first two in the tagged order, and the hover shows every recipient.
  • The Tagged: line is not shown when the only recipient is the note's own author, and it never lists the author.
  • Recipient email addresses are never shown, including on hover.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10245 (S2, Read a notification); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S2; design board InboxAfter; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R3: “When the note has recipients other than its author, a Tagged: line names them.”
  • S2-R8: “The Tagged: line shows two recipient names inline, then "+N more" for the rest (for example, "Ashlee Thomas, Ashley Schultz +2 more"). The two shown are the first two in the order the author tagged them; the hover carries the full list.”
  • S2-R9: “Hovering the Tagged: line shows every recipient's name.”
  • S2-N1: “The Tagged: line is not shown when the only recipient is the note's own author; it never lists the author.”
  • S2-N2: “Recipient email addresses are never shown on the notification, including on hover.”
